question: Assume today is 2026-03-21. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total value of New Zealand's goods exports in March 2026 (actual monthly value, not seasonally adjusted), in New Zealand dollars (NZD), as it will be first reported in Stats NZ's monthly Overseas merchandise trade release.

target.what: Total value of New Zealand goods exports (overseas merchandise trade, exports f.o.b.) for the calendar month of March 2026, as first published by Stats NZ in its monthly Overseas Merchandise Trade release
target.caveats: Target period is future relative to the 2026-03-21 cutoff (only ~3 weeks of March elapsed), so the value is not yet observed; must be projected. Definition is exports f.o.b. in NZD, not seasonally adjusted, as first released (subject to later revision). Excludes services; goods only. Working interpr

candidates.hypothesis: March export values follow a recurring seasonal pattern; the March 2026 value can be projected from prior March values plus recent monthly trend. Role: baseline level and seasonality.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly goods export values (NZD, actual) for March in each of 2021-2025 and the most recent months (Dec 2025-Feb 2026) published before cutoff; ideally the full monthly series to compute March seasonal factor and recent YoY growth.

candidates.hypothesis: March exports are dominated by dairy, meat, and forestry; projecting each major commodity's March value and summing gives the total. Role: component decomposition.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly export values by commodity (dairy, meat, logs/wood, fruit, wine, machinery) for recent months and prior Marches; or March 2026 dairy auction/volume signals.
